text_block_list.text:
One day as the Oka Sho drew near. Air 
Groove spots Mejiro Dober pouring herself 
into training with an almost demonic 
intensity.

Ashamed of having achieved nothing 
compared to fellow Mejiro family members 
Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, she had 
pushed herself into a cycle of 
overtraining.

Troubled and cornered by her own thoughts, 
Mejiro Dober struggles.

In order to guide her, Air Groove vowed to 
show the "ideal" through her running as 
she pursued the Triple Tiara.
